description.value: Whistler Core Climbing & Fitness Gym is a full-service training facility located in the lower level of the Whistler Conference Center in Whistler Village. It offers a climbing gym with bouldering, top-roping, auto-belays, and an adjustable training wall, alongside a comprehensive fitness floor featuring Olympic weightlifting platforms, cardio equipment, and a functional fitness studio. The gym also runs guided outdoor rock climbing experiences, making it a hub for active visitors seeking both indoor training and backcountry adventure.
